title: Replace Privacy & Safety page with app-store compliant Privacy Policy

requirements.text: Replace the existing “Privacy & Safety” grown-ups page content with a legally compliant Privacy Policy page for a children’s app, keeping a gentle, friendly tone and short, parent-readable paragraphs, suitable for worldwide use.

quotes: Update the current “Privacy & Safety” page and convert it into a proper legal Privacy Policy page suitable for a children's app published on app stores (Google Play + Apple App Store Kids Category).

acceptanceCriteria: The existing page at frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafetyPage.tsx is fully rewritten (old content removed) into a Privacy Policy intended for a children’s app on Google Play and Apple App Store Kids Category.
Language is simple enough for parents to understand, with short paragraphs and a child-safe friendly tone while remaining legally clear.
Text does not mention or rely on any region-specific assumptions and is written for worldwide use.

requirements.text: Update the page title to exactly “Privacy Policy – My Health Buddy” and render the policy as clearly separated sections with headings in this exact order: No Personal Data Collection, Offline Use, Children’s Privacy, Data Storage, Medical Disclaimer, Third-Party Services, Changes, Contact, Ownership.

quotes:
Create a page titled:
Privacy Policy – My Health Buddy
Add these sections clearly separated with headings:

acceptanceCriteria: ScreenLayout title for the page is exactly “Privacy Policy – My Health Buddy”.
All required sections appear as distinct headings in the exact order specified.
Each section is visually separated (e.g., separate cards or consistent spacing/dividers) and easy to scan.

requirements.text: In the “No Personal Data Collection” section, state clearly that the app does NOT collect names, email, location, contacts, photos, microphone recordings, health data, analytics, identifiers, cookies, or tracking, using plain language.

quotes: State clearly the app does NOT collect names, email, location, contacts, photos, microphone recordings, health data, analytics, identifiers, cookies or tracking.

acceptanceCriteria: The section explicitly lists all the following as not collected: names, email, location, contacts, photos, microphone recordings, health data, analytics, identifiers, cookies, tracking.
The wording is unambiguous that no collection occurs.

requirements.text: In the “Offline Use” section, explain that the app works completely offline and nothing leaves the device.

quotes: Explain the app works completely offline and nothing leaves the device.

acceptanceCriteria: The policy states the app works completely offline.
The policy states that nothing leaves the device.

requirements.text: In the “Children’s Privacy” section, state the app is designed for children with parent/teacher/carer supervision and complies with COPPA and GDPR-K because no personal data is collected.

quotes: State the app is designed for children with parent/teacher/carer supervision and complies with COPPA and GDPR-K because no personal data is collected.

acceptanceCriteria: The policy explicitly mentions COPPA and GDPR-K compliance rationale as “because no personal data is collected”.
The policy states the app is designed for children with parent/teacher/carer supervision.

requirements.text: In the “Data Storage” section, explain that selections remain locally on the device and can be reset anytime.

quotes: Explain selections remain locally on the device and can be reset anytime.

acceptanceCriteria: The policy states selections are stored locally on the device only.
The policy states saved selections/data can be reset at any time.

requirements.text: In the “Medical Disclaimer” section, clarify the app is only a communication tool and not medical advice.

quotes: Clarify the app is only a communication tool and not medical advice.

acceptanceCriteria: The policy states the app is a communication tool.
The policy states it is not medical advice.

requirements.text: In the “Third-Party Services” section, state there are no ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, and no third-party sharing.

quotes: State no ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, no third-party sharing.

acceptanceCriteria: The section explicitly states: no ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, and no third-party sharing.

requirements.text: In the “Changes” section, state the policy will update if app features change.

quotes: Policy will update if features change.

acceptanceCriteria: The policy includes a Changes section stating the policy may be updated if features change.

requirements.text: In the “Contact” section, include the placeholder email address exactly: support@myhealthbuddy.app
acceptanceCriteria: The Contact section includes the email address exactly “support@myhealthbuddy.app”.

requirements.text: In the “Ownership” section, include exactly: “© Gabriella Gayle — My Health Buddy and Luma character are original creations.”

quotes:
Ownership
© Gabriella Gayle — My Health Buddy and Luma character are original creations.

acceptanceCriteria: The Ownership section includes the provided ownership line exactly as written, including the em dash.

requirements.text: Update the grown-ups navigation label that opens the privacy page to match the new page purpose by changing the button text from “Privacy & Safety” to “Privacy Policy” in the Grown-ups Area.

quotes: Update the current “Privacy & Safety” page and convert it into a proper legal Privacy Policy page

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsAreaPage.tsx, the button that navigates to 'grownups-privacy' is labeled “Privacy Policy”.
Navigation destination remains 'grownups-privacy' and continues to work.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn components).
Keep all user-facing policy text in English.
Replace the old privacy page content entirely; do not keep the previous “Privacy & Safety” copy.
nonGoals: Implementing new tracking, analytics, ads, or any third-party SDK integrations.
Adding Internet Identity authentication changes or backend data storage for privacy policy content.
Creating new routes or changing the screen navigation architecture beyond updating the label text as specified.
